items.title: Welcome to my blog
items.summary: A quick hello — what I'll write about here, and a demo of embedding videos, PDFs, and images in a post.
items.body:
This is my new blog, where I'll share **notes on my research**, paper walkthroughs, and the occasional deep dive into code clones, software engineering, and machine learning.

## What you'll find here

- Plain-language summaries of my papers
- Video walkthroughs of talks and presentations
- Tutorials and tools I build along the way

## Embedding a video

Paste a YouTube link on its own line and it becomes a player:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jNQXAC9IVRw

## Embedding a PDF

Drop a PDF link on its own line to preview it inline:

> Tip: you can also add a **video link to any publication** from the admin — a *Watch* button shows up right on the paper card.

## Code and images

Inline `code`, fenced blocks:

```
def hello():
    print("hello, world")
```

And images with `![caption](url)`. That's it — write in Markdown and it just works.
